infotexts.entitydescription.subdermal_thoracic_1:
The Subdermal Thoracic Armour Reinforcment is a series of connected, overlaping metal plates which conform to the ribcage as it moves during breathing. Does not prevent blunt-force trauma to the chest or damage to other parts of the body
C.O.R.E. The Cardiopulmonary Overlay & Ribcage Exoskeleton, while technically not an exoskeleton, provides superb protection none-the-less against most forms of attack. Is also the attatchment point for the optional A.E.G.I.S. plate.
A.E.G.I.S. The Abdominal Extended Graft Integrated System is an additional plate attatched to a C.O.R.E. in order to shield the belly from damage. Is similar in protection to the S.T.A.R. but for the kidneys and liver
